attempts.summary: Set up nginx on node1 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 using a self-signed certificate managed by an automated renewal pipeline (renew-cert.sh + cert-renew.service/timer). The timer checks cert expiry daily (openssl x509 -checkend against a 15-day window on 30-day certs) and, when a cert is due, atomically regenerates key/cert and does `systemctl reload nginx` for zero-downtime pickup. Verified the full pipeline live: installed a near-expiry test cert, fired the same service unit the timer invokes, and confirmed nginx renewed the cert and reloaded while 80 concurrent HTTPS polls all returned 200 with no failures, and the live TLS handshake immediately served the new certificate. Also configured firewalld (8443/tcp) and SELinux (http_port_t) for the port, and enabled nginx + cert-renew.timer to start on boot. Completed the mandatory node1 restart: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy service/cert state, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified nginx, the renewal timer, firewall/SELinux config, and the HTTPS endpoint (serving the same renewed cert) all recovered post-restart.
